text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As a child, Yamanin Zephyr dreamed of becoming the wind. She long looked up to the Mile Emperor, but now, her goal is to surpass her and become a tempest like no other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Another "Emperor", Symboli Rudolf, is in the stands—with a certain Umamusume in the seat beside her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Embracing myriad expectations, Zephyr prepares to clear the final hurdle on her path to becoming an unprecedented triple-distance champion. It's time for the autumn Tenno Sho.
